adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the code appends `contents << "... #{url} ..."` using the unescaped `url` (only guarded by `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`). Imported posts are created with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and `Post#cook` returns `raw` directly for `:raw_html`, bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. The embed view renders `raw post.cooked`, so any quote/attribute-breaking characters in `url` would be persisted and rendered as raw HTML, enabling attribute/HTML injection/XSS via a crafted `embed_url`/feed link.
